exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.1.1–1.3.7 — seizure assessment, EEG, and imaging
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports seizure-event and witness history, physical examination, ECG or metabolic context, EEG review, MRI review, recurrence after remission, and specialist assessment.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Epilepsies in children, young people and adults

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 2.1.1–2.1.11 — information, safety, and daily impact
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports trigger, adherence, side-effect, safety, driving, employment or education, reproductive-health, and care-plan discussions.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Epilepsies in children, young people and adults

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 4.1.1–4.5.11 — treatment, monitoring, and review
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports seizure-control and adverse-effect review, clinician-led medication and interaction review, antiseizure medication levels when indicated, care review, and pregnancy-related specialist review without mapping a dose.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Epilepsies in children, young people and adults

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 7.1.1–7.3.1 — status, cluster, and prolonged seizure plans
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports documentation of seizure clusters or convulsive emergencies and a clinician-agreed individual emergency management plan without mapping emergency medication or doses.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Epilepsies in children, young people and adults

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 10.1.1–10.2.2 — epilepsy-related death and SUDEP risk
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports seizure frequency, adherence, alcohol or drug use, uncontrolled seizures, abnormal neurological findings, and clinician-documented risk and safety discussion.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Suspected neurological conditions: recognition and referral

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.2.1–1.2.7 — dizziness and vertigo in adults
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports focal neurological and hearing red flags, acute vestibular syndrome, HINTS by trained clinicians, neuroimaging referral, and Hallpike assessment for positional vertigo.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Suspected neurological conditions: recognition and referral

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.7.1–1.7.10 and 1.10.1–1.10.6 — limb weakness and sensory symptoms
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports sudden, progressive, fluctuating, unilateral, symmetrical, sensory-associated, and back-pain-associated weakness, urgent referral, and clinician-led imaging where specified.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Suspected neurological conditions: recognition and referral

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.10.1–1.10.13 — sensory symptoms including tingling or numbness in adults
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports sudden unilateral numbness, rapidly progressive symmetrical sensory change with weakness or imbalance, recurrent sensory episodes, distal sensory distribution, reflex and gait context, selected metabolic tests, radicular symptoms, bowel or bladder context, and clinician-led referral.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Suspected neurological conditions: recognition and referral

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.15.1–1.15.4 — tremor in adults
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports rest or asymmetric tremor, stiffness, slowness, balance or gait difficulty, symmetrical postural tremor, medicine, thyroid and alcohol review, functional impact, head tremor, and clinician-led referral.
